name: Losing Importance
source:
Dominik just walks towards his monthly bingo game, while being rudely interrupted by a robin in a wheelchair.

Experience a small journey they go through.

[From [url=https://peppekzmagimerlin.itch.io/losing-importance]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
多米尼克正走向每月一次的宾果游戏，却被一只坐在轮椅上的知更鸟粗鲁地打断了。

体验他们经历的一段小旅程。

[来自[url=https://peppekzmagimerlin.itch.io/losing-importance]Itch.io[/url]]
